title: アルダンの寄り道講座・初級編

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan and I are on our way back from an outing when she somewhat timidly proposes something.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer. If you're in no particular hurry to get back, would you be interested in a small detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's for me to know and you to look forward to… Hehe! I may not look it, but I happen to be quite the detour connoisseur.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: After all, since arriving at the academy, I've grown quite fond of going out to explore after classes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… You'll enjoy where we're going, I assure you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After quite a while, we end up at a famous aquarium. I've heard so much about this place but never found the time to come see it for myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Breathtaking, isn't it? Enormous tanks, an underwater tunnel, and a vibrant array of aquatic animals…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe! …I must admit I only recently discovered this place. I stumbled across it on one of my detours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I only stepped inside on a whim, but the experience was more magical than I could have imagined.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: As they say, you simply won't know until you go. That's the true charm of the detour.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There are still so many exhibits I wish to show you. Come along, I'll guide you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure she's ever been this insistent before. I find myself charmed by the ambiance as we go from tank to tank…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And then the next one's—oh?

text_block_list.name: Small Boy
text_block_list.text: Aww… They're not here…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A family of orcas is supposed to be housed here…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Granted, it is a massive tank, but there's no sign of them at all… Perhaps they're resting towards the back?

text_block_list.name: Small Boy
text_block_list.text: I guess I won't get to see any orcas today… Aw…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Watch this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Phwwwht.

text_block_list.name: Small Boy
text_block_list.text: Was that an orca?! Where is it?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehehe… Where indeed. ♪ Phwwwht! ♪

text_block_list.name: Small Boy
text_block_list.text: …Whoa?! That was you? Holy cow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… When I was a child, there was a television in the hospital and I happened to see a documentary on animal calls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I thought that if I learned the noises, I'd one day be able to converse with animals myself. I spent quite a lot of time practicing in secret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Though, it is rather embarrassing to open up about this now.

text_block_list.name: Small Boy
text_block_list.text: …Whoa?! Look! An orca!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Baby Orca
text_block_list.text: Phwwht?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Is it responding to Mejiro Ardan's call? …While I ponder that question, the whole pod ends up looking this way in a confused manner.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My my, this is really something… What a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Small Boy
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! You can talk to orcas! …Hey, teach me! Teach me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it would be my pleasure. Firstly, to hit the right pitch, you'll need to…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: What a wonderful surprise that was. I wonder what sort of message I was conveying to them through those calls.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To think that a childhood dream of mine would come true today… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Well, I do feel slightly embarrassed but… Hehe, thank you. ♪
choice_data_list: Could you make that call again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh? As in right here and now? Well, I'm not sure that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. Then I suppose I must.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phwwwht! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, aren't they just? I knew you'd enjoy yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad. What a marvelous feeling it is to be able to convey how special something is, and to share it with someone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I do hope that we can go on finding many more wonderful places together.
